description: This file defines a frontend component for a shopping cart page using LightningJS framework. It imports UI components and a theme, then constructs a CartPage component that includes a header, cart view, floating button, and checkout modal, managing its state with a store subscription.

classes.name: CartPage
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the shopping cart page, including header, cart view, action button, and checkout modal, with reactive state binding to a shared store.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Subscribes to AppStore updates to toggle 'checkoutOpen' state based on store value.
